title: MuunCode
description: MuunCode is a Web IDE that lets you build Embedded Software fast enough to reach the Moon.
philosophy: MuunCode lets you use HTML, CSS and JavaScript to design UI and Scripts you can then compile and flash to low-cost microcontroller development boards like the ESP32 (LilyGO, CrowPanel, M5Stack, DevKit), Arduino and Raspberry.
browserNotice: MuunCode's device flashing feature requires a Chromium-based browser (Chrome, Edge, or Opera). Firefox and Safari are not supported for that feature.
